description: Let the user choose None, All system audio, or One app as a call-audio source, captured by a Core Audio process tap and mixed with the microphone into one 16 kHz mono WAV.

specs.description: The call-audio source setting offers exactly three values and defaults to None.
specs.given: a fresh install on a Mac that supports process taps and the user opens Settings → Recording
specs.when: the call-audio source setting is shown
specs.then: the choices are None, All system audio and One app, and None is selected

specs.description: Choosing One app lists running apps and records only that app's output.
specs.given: the source is One app, with Zoom chosen from the list of running apps and other apps also playing sound
specs.when: the user starts a recording
specs.then: the tap targets only Zoom's output and the other apps' audio is not in the recording

specs.description: All system audio records everything the Mac plays.
specs.given: the source is All system audio and two different apps are playing sound
specs.when: the user starts a recording
specs.then: the tap is created for all system output and both apps' audio is present in the recording

specs.description: Source None never creates a tap and changes nothing from today's microphone-only behaviour.
specs.given: the source is None
specs.when: the user starts and stops a recording
specs.then: no tap is created, no call-audio permission is requested, and the recording contains the microphone only, exactly as before

specs.description: One app cannot be started without a chosen app.
specs.given: the source is One app but no app has been chosen, or the chosen app is no longer running
specs.when: the user starts a recording
specs.then: no tap is created for any other app or for all system audio, the user is told no app is selected, and the recording proceeds with microphone only

specs.description: Capture uses a Core Audio process tap and asks only for System Audio Recording permission.
specs.given: the source is All system audio on macOS 14.2 or later
specs.when: the user picks the source and starts a recording
specs.then: the tap is built with a Core Audio tap description, only the System Audio Recording Only permission is requested, and Screen Recording is never requested

specs.description: On an older OS the setting is hidden and the microphone path is unchanged.
specs.given: the Mac runs a macOS version earlier than 14.2
specs.when: the user opens Settings → Recording and starts a recording
specs.then: the call-audio source setting is not shown, no tap is attempted, and the recording is microphone only

specs.description: ScreenCaptureKit is never used for call audio.
specs.given: any source setting and any permission state
specs.when: call audio is captured
specs.then: no ScreenCaptureKit capture is started and no Screen Recording prompt appears

specs.description: Mic and tap are mixed into one 16 kHz mono WAV.
specs.given: the source is All system audio, the microphone carries one voice and the tap carries another
specs.when: a recording is made and stopped
specs.then: exactly one WAV file results, 16 kHz mono, containing both voices, and transcription, speaker labelling and summary receive it unchanged

specs.description: The tap starts and stops with Record.
specs.given: the source is One app and the app is running
specs.when: the user presses Record and later Stop
specs.then: the tap starts at Record, stops at Stop, and no audio is captured before or after

specs.description: A chosen app quitting mid-recording ends the tap but not the recording.
specs.given: a recording is in progress with One app set to Zoom
specs.when: Zoom quits
specs.then: the tap ends, the microphone keeps recording, and on Stop the single WAV is saved with audio up to the quit and the microphone after it

specs.description: Echo is not doubled: a remote voice present in both mic and tap is not heard twice.
specs.given: speakers are in use, so the remote voice is in the tap and also leaks into the microphone with a delay
specs.when: the two are mixed
specs.then: the remote voice appears once in the mix, not as a doubled or echoed signal, and the level is not raised by the duplicate

specs.description: Nothing is written outside the single recording file.
specs.given: a recording with a tap in progress
specs.when: the recording runs and stops
specs.then: no separate tap file or other audio file is written anywhere, and the only artefact is the one WAV

specs.description: For any mix of mic and tap input the output is a single 16 kHz mono stream with no clipping.
specs.given: any mic signal and any tap signal, of any sample rate, channel count and length, including silence on either one
specs.when: they are mixed
specs.then: the output is mono at 16 kHz, its length covers the longer input, samples stay within range, and silence on one input leaves the other audible

specs.description: Permission is asked when the user picks a source, not at launch.
specs.given: a first launch, then the user selects All system audio in Settings
specs.when: the app launches and later the source is picked
specs.then: no call-audio permission is requested at launch, and it is requested when the source is picked, using the same Allow card as ADR-2611142200

specs.description: A refused permission offers Open Settings.
specs.given: the permission card is shown after picking a source and the user does not allow it
specs.when: the user refuses
specs.then: the card offers Open Settings, following the Allow then Open Settings rule of ADR-2611142200

specs.description: Refusal falls back to microphone only with a visible message.
specs.given: the user has refused the call-audio permission and the source is All system audio or One app
specs.when: the user starts a recording
specs.then: no tap is created, the recording is microphone only, and a visible message says call audio is not being recorded because permission was refused

specs.description: No permission request when the source is None or at launch.
specs.given: the source is None
specs.when: the app launches and the user records
specs.then: the call-audio permission is never requested

specs.description: Recordings use the tap when a source is set.
specs.given: the source is One app and the user starts a meeting recording
specs.when: the recording starts
specs.then: the tap is requested for that recording

specs.description: Dictation and Notes never request the tap or its permission.
specs.given: the source is All system audio with permission not yet granted
specs.when: the user starts Dictation or records in Notes
specs.then: no tap is created, no call-audio permission is requested, and only the microphone is used

specs.description: Only the Recordings mode can ever cause a tap.
specs.given: any recording mode among Dictation, Notes and Recordings, and any source setting and permission state
specs.when: capture starts
specs.then: a tap is created only if the mode is Recordings, the source is not None, and permission is granted

specs.description: Privacy documents are updated together and state audio stays on this Mac.
specs.given: the change is ready for acceptance
specs.when: the README, the Settings footnote, the in-app Help, docs/PRIVACY.md and the earshot-privacy-map skill are read
specs.then: each states that audio stays on this Mac and that other people's voices may now be recorded, and Help says consent is the user's responsibility

specs.description: No privacy surface is left stale and no audio leaves the Mac.
specs.given: call audio is being recorded
specs.when: the app is used and its network activity is observed
specs.then: no audio is sent off the Mac, and none of the five privacy surfaces still describes recording as microphone only

specs.description: Source choice and mixing are pure and the tap sits behind a port.
specs.given: the domain and use-case code with a fake tap adapter behind the port
specs.when: a recording is run with each source value
specs.then: the source choice and the mix are computed without Core Audio, and the fake tap supplies the call audio

specs.description: Domain and use-case code do not depend on Core Audio.
specs.given: the domain and use-case modules
specs.when: their dependencies are inspected
specs.then: none import Core Audio, AVFoundation or CATapDescription; only the driven adapter does

specs.description: Source choice and mixing are deterministic and free of side effects.
specs.given: any source setting, OS capability, permission state and pair of input signals
specs.when: the source choice and mix are evaluated twice
specs.then: the results are identical and nothing is read from or written to the system
